title: Valid Read File Record subrequest
purpose: Increase operation and field-layout diversity with a valid 0x14 request that includes a byte-counted file-record subrequest, covering a more nested parser shape than simple register reads.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the Read File Record request with one subrequest item and either return file-record data if supported or a clean exception response.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0x0009 matches unit identifier plus 8-byte PDU
Function code 0x14 is documented for Read File Record
Byte count 0x06 matches one complete file-record subrequest body
Subrequest preserves reference type plus file number, record number, and record length field ordering
issue_safety_notes: Chosen as a safe structural broadening seed with nested length-bearing fields; it is fully framed and not an exact reproduction of any historical crafted overflow payload.
